comparators.combined_seven: Best of the existing six owner-priority paths and the fixed 0,1,2 stage-priority path.
comparators.exact: Independent breadth-first search of every literal safe interval phase between compatible physical states.

comparators.stage_fixed: At each target-directed one-rank step choose the enabled owner with least current rank; break ties by 0,1,2; then find the exact minimum-phase partition of that path.
comparators.stage_six: Best exact partition of the six least-current-rank paths, one per static owner tie order.
